prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native Android design-direction comp
Primary request: Create one full-screen MealOS cooking-mode interface as the conventional polished category baseline.
Scene/backdrop: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra unfolded viewport, 2504 x 2256 pixels, near-square landscape; screenshot content only with no device frame.
Subject: MealOS cooking mode for ‘Garlic-herb chicken + baby potatoes + broccoli,’ portion mode ‘Dinner + lunch tomorrow.’ Equal-weight two-pane layout around a vertical hinge. Left pane shows current step 2 of 5 in large readable type, clear progress, and a Start/Next control. Right pane shows scaled ingredients and two live timers labeled Potatoes 12:48 and Chicken 08:20. Adaptive navigation rail labels: Today, Plan, Recipes, Grocery.
Style/medium: polished conventional Material 3 recipe app; clean white and warm off-white surfaces, muted herb-green primary, charcoal text, soft rounded recipe cards, restrained appetizing food photography, native Android components and tonal elevation.
Composition/framing: operational app screen, not a poster; edge-to-edge with system-safe spacing, 48dp touch targets, excellent reading hierarchy.
Text (verbatim where visible): ‘MealOS’, ‘Garlic-herb chicken’, ‘Dinner + lunch tomorrow’, ‘Step 2 of 5’, ‘Add the chicken’, ‘Potatoes 12:48’, ‘Chicken 08:20’, ‘Today’, ‘Plan’, ‘Recipes’, ‘Grocery’.
Constraints: Equal visual weight between step pane and ingredients/timers pane. Modern Android, adult, clear, realistic interface.
Avoid: illegible filler text, invented commercial claims, iOS controls, phone bezel, generic dashboard, poster composition, excessive cards, gradients, glassmorphism.
